description: Audit constructs, ΔE, batch, DMS & epistasis.

construct_seq.description: Single-chain raw amino acid sequence or inline FASTA to audit; omit if supplying fasta_query.

fasta_query.description: Single- or multi-chain FASTA (or ':'-delimited raw chains) for monomer/multimer audit; mutually exclusive with construct_seq.

include_curves.description: Include 17-point pH 5.5-9.5 titration curves (default false unless detail='full').

include_epistasis.description: Opt-in MI_APC co-evolutionary couplings and 3D/MSA fitness scoring (default false for sequence audits; true for cluster-only lookups).

parent.description: Optional wild-type parent (vault/.p3d accession, FASTA, or raw AA sequence; auto-enables include_epistasis unless false).

scan_mutagenesis_span.description: 1-based inclusive window {start,end} or [start,end] (<=64 cols) for in-silico saturation mutagenesis.

where.description: Optional SQL-like metadata filter expression or prior @h_xxxx result handle to scope homolog/cluster selection.

name: pvault_evaluate_construct
